scripts.dev:all: npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev & npm --prefix Admin run dev
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:admin: cd Admin && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build && cd .. && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true}); fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', {recursive:true});"
